findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "swap" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "protocol" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: product_api, walletconnect · Private data: swap, orderbook, product_api, aqua, walletconnect · Public sink: swap, orderbook, product_api · Destructive: swap, orderbook, aqua, walletconnect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: product_api, walletconnect · Private data: swap, orderbook, product_api, aqua, walletconnect · Public sink: swap, orderbook, product_api · Destructive: swap, orderbook, aqua, walletconnect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
